name: Die Waldruhe
beschreibung:
Nestled in the untouched natural landscapes of the mountaineering village of Kartitsch in East Tyrol, Hotel Die Waldruhe welcomes guests with genuine warmth and contemporary alpine comfort. Elegantly styled rooms and an inviting spa guarantee restful recuperation.

The surrounding area provides ideal conditions for hikes along the Carnic High Trail, gentle winter tourism, ski touring, and cross-country skiing against a dramatic Dolomite backdrop.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Die Waldruhe in Kartitsch offers relaxing wellness and nature holidays in the pristine Tyrolean Gailtal valley.
